outcome: Delivery rates within specific time intervals (12, 24, 36, 48 hours)
Vaginal delivery rates within specific time intervals (12, 36 hours)
cohort: 1555 full-term pregnant women (226 with GDM, 1329 with normal glucose tolerance) who underwent labor induction with dinoprostone vaginal inserts
finding: While there was no significant difference in overall time to delivery between GDM and NGT groups, GDM was associated with lower rates of delivery within specific time intervals after adjusting for confounding factors.
